How to participate?

Sign in
Or register. From June 1 to June 7. Only FunPay users are eligible to take the shot at our discounts.
Spin the wheel
Press «Feeling lucky» and choose the discount. The system will choose one at random automatically. Come back for a new discount after 24 hours.
Claim the prize
Get your discount from the profile page. It will appear right after you win it. Discounts are valid during the giveaway.
Buy UC with your discount
A UC pack eligible for the discount will be highlighted in your ticket. Press «Use», get some sweet UC and come back for the new prize after 24 hours!
